chunks.rationale: Single-token change in src/index.css: --text-dim #667085 -> #7d8798. The sidebar (projects/threadbar) renders most secondary text (branch names, ages, counts, provider tags, 'New thread' rows, group summaries) in --text-dim, which sat at ~3.7:1 contrast on --bg-elevated — below WCAG AA. The new value lands ~5:1 on the sidebar background and ~4.7:1 on card fills, while staying clearly darker than --text-muted (#8b95a8, ~6:1) so the dim/muted/text hierarchy survives. Token-level fix beats per-rule overrides in Sidebar.module.css: one line, no hardcoded colors, and other dim text app-wide benefits too.
risks: Dim text everywhere in the app gets brighter, not just the sidebar — intentional, but reviewers should confirm the dim/muted steps still read as distinct.
Settled rows still multiply the token by opacity 0.6 (intentional recession); they improve but remain low-contrast by design.
Only one test references the token (test/conflictForecastBadge.test.tsx, regex on the variable name, not the hex value); no snapshot pins the old color.
Contrast ratios were computed analytically from the hex values, not measured in a running app.
